profile: Native deterministic patch-similarity reward with declared offline policy and tmux tooling adaptation. No model judge.
limitations: Admission is for continuous patch similarity only, not functional correctness, compilation, biological reasoning, pass@1, Atlas admission or training readiness.
Pure scorer assigns substantial structural credit to reversed changes and small credit to unrelated edits. Scores must retain this meaning.
Reference text patch application and exact native runtime 0/1 controls do not establish semantic equivalence of arbitrary alternate fixes.
Image recipe uses a mutable public base tag and build-time package resolution; built runtime provenance is retained, no public pinned training image claimed.
